en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.29 - Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)
about a man who slaughtered a sheep, which then convulsed and fell into a well while its veins were still bleeding. He asked if one could perform ablution from that well.
Imam (as) said: "Between thirty and forty buckets should be drawn from it, and then it may be used for ablution."
